title: Analyze SparseCore Offload and Sync Failures
description: Deterministic diagnostic action to triage SparseCore (SC) offload mismatches (`--xla_tpu_enable_sparse_core_mismatch_detector=true`), SparseCore HBM/SRAM/Smem OOMs, and TensorCore-to-SparseCore `sflag` synchronization timeouts.

logs.description: Raw or formatted log entries containing SparseCore mismatch, sequencer halt, or sflag timeout telemetry.

logs_file.description: Optional file path containing the workload logs (e.g. scratch/queried_logs.txt).

start_time.description: Optional ISO-8601 start timestamp for log query fallback.

end_time.description: Optional ISO-8601 end timestamp for log query fallback.
